body: Soap, work gloves, and two sample jars, paid cash. My note says the fertilizer crew left oily residue here before the road was closed.
title: feed-store receipt under the drums
gloss: A personal trace links farm-program residue to symptoms before a restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while crossing treated land; the personal trace does not by itself prove the farm program caused the emergency.

title: The disposal count
body: The hauler was told the dump road was clear and took a detour to avoid the crowded main route. The gate had been welded shut that morning. He wrote down the time because the dispatch sheet still charged him for arriving late.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
